messages:
nina: flagging a billing divergence we tracked to edge retries + batch replays. tenant A showed ~1.6x token billing for a short spike this morning. repro attached.

leo: can you paste repro steps?

nina: repro: client POST -> edge 502 -> client retries quickly -> proxy replay puts both into batcher -> runtime counts tokens for both. looks like no dedupe key survives.

tara: current batcher dedup uses payload_hash+arrival_window. retries often change trace headers so hash !=.

ben: simple thought: introduce an ingest-level fingerprint header (X-RW-FP) assigned at accept time and forwarded to batcher. batcher uses that as primary dedupe.

leo: browser clients won't echo response headers on 502s. setting header on response won't help client retries.

tara: correct. but proxy can assign fp early and include it on the upstream request to batcher, so internal systems see it. that still won't collapse client-initiated retries that re-connect.

nina: alternative: proxy maintains a short-lived dedupe cache keyed by (client-ip, short-body-hash) with TTL 5s and collapses immediate retries. cheap and effective for most cases.

ben: memory and NAT blew up concerns. need sharded LRU and consistent eviction. also need to avoid blocking legitimate different clients behind same NAT.

leo: runtime-side dedupe as last line of defense: when batch completes, runtime can prefilter pairs with len+prefix-hash and then canonicalize JSON bodies to decide dedupe before accounting. Pseudocode: 
```
if (len(a)!=len(b)) false
if (cheap_hash(a[0:64])!=cheap_hash(b[0:64])) false
return canonical_hash(a)==canonical_hash(b)
```

tara: canonicalization lib must be shared between edge and runtime and versioned (fp_v). otherwise mismatches will increase misses.

nina: proposal plan: 1) proxy short-replay-index (5s TTL) 2) batcher: accept X-RW-FP if present and fallback to canonical payload hash 3) runtime: prefilter+canonical dedupe before token accounting 4) metrics: dedupe_attempts/dedup_successes and est_cost_savings per-tenant.

ben: QA: run spike with sampled tenant traces, simulate retries and streaming partials. need to ensure we don't merge semantically different JSON requests (use stable-serialize + whitelist headers).

ops-bot: created ticket PLAT-999 "edge-short-replay-cache + request-fingerprint" and a staging canary branch.

leo: action items: nina attach sample traces to the ticket; tara sketch canonicalizer and share lib; ben spike LRU shard plan for proxy; i'll add dashboards for dedupe metrics. reconvene tomorrow 9:30am PT. :thumbsup:
